drug_class: Tyrosine hydroxylase inhibitor / catecholamine synthesis inhibitor
purpose: Metyrosine is used to treat a rare adrenal gland tumor called pheochromocytoma, which causes your body to make too much adrenaline-like chemicals. It helps control dangerous spikes in blood pressure caused by this tumor. It is often used before surgery to remove the tumor or in patients who cannot have surgery.
how_it_works: Your adrenal gland normally makes stress chemicals called catecholamines, like adrenaline, which raise your blood pressure and heart rate. Metyrosine blocks an enzyme called tyrosine hydroxylase, which is the first step in making these chemicals. By blocking this step, the medication reduces the amount of adrenaline-like substances your body produces, helping keep your blood pressure safer and more stable.
common_side_effects: Feeling very drowsy or sedated is the most common side effect. You may also notice feeling anxious, shaky, or having trouble speaking clearly. Some people experience diarrhea, nausea, dry mouth, or feel unusually tired. Crystals can sometimes form in the urine, so drinking plenty of water is very important.
warnings: Do not drive or operate heavy machinery until you know how this medicine affects you, because it can cause significant drowsiness. Drink plenty of fluids every day to prevent kidney stones from forming. Tell your doctor about all other medications you take, especially sedatives or antipsychotics, as the drowsiness effect can be made much worse. Do not stop taking this medication suddenly without talking to your doctor first. Tell your doctor right away if you develop muscle stiffness, uncontrolled movements, or signs of depression.
typical_dosing: The usual starting dose for adults is 250 mg taken by mouth four times a day. Your doctor may gradually increase your dose up to a maximum of 4,000 mg per day, depending on how your body responds and how well your symptoms are controlled. Always take it exactly as your doctor prescribes and drink at least 6 to 8 full glasses of water daily.
